query:
INSERT IGNORE INTO plant_molecules (plant_id, molecule_id, percentage_min, percentage_max, role, link_notes)
SELECT p.id, m.id, 5.0, 25.0, 'majeur', CONCAT('Composant naturel de ', p.name)
FROM molecules m
CROSS JOIN plants p
WHERE m.id NOT IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM plant_molecules)
AND (
  -- Agrumes pour terpènes citriques
  (m.name LIKE '%limonene%' AND p.name LIKE '%Citrus%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%linalool%' AND p.name LIKE '%Lavandula%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%geraniol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Pelargonium%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%eugenol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Syzygium%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%thymol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Thymus%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%carvacrol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Origanum%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%menthol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Mentha%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%camphor%' AND p.name LIKE '%Cinnamomum%')
  OR (m.name LIKE '%borneol%' AND p.name LIKE '%Rosmarinus%')
)
LIMIT 30;
